title: Rusted Cache
description: Behind a collapsed wall of rotted planks, you spot an iron lockbox half-buried in debris. Rust cakes the hinges, but the lock mechanism looks intact. This was hidden deliberately — someone's emergency fund, perhaps.

choices.label: Force it open
choices.description: Brute strength, but risk a trap.

outcomes.text: The lock snaps with a satisfying crack. Gold coins and iron fittings spill out — jackpot!
A spring-loaded blade slices your palm as you wrench the lid! The gold inside barely compensates.
You force it open but the coins are corroded green. Still worth something to a smith, along with the iron box itself.

choices.label: Work the corroded lock
choices.description: Patient effort might open it safely.

outcomes.text: Click. The mechanism gives way to careful manipulation. A tidy sum awaits inside.
The lock yields, but the contents are disappointing. Mostly corroded copper with a few silver pieces.
Your improvised lockpick snaps inside. Frustrated, you pry the box open anyway — and find a hidden tray beneath!

choices.label: Just take the iron box
choices.description: The box itself is worth something.

outcomes.text: Good iron is hard to find. The lockbox breaks down into quality scrap.
As you lift the box, coins rattle inside. Bonus! The lock pops open from the jostling.
